subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw accept this experimental core-owned Claws mutation lifecycle—agent/workspace creation plus root provenance—as the next supported slice of the open Claws stack?
rationale: The change defines new persistent state and public CLI behavior rather than repairing an established contract; code review cannot determine whether core, rather than a plugin or a deferred design, should own this lifecycle.

options.title: Sponsor the core lifecycle
options.body: Accept the staged core direction, require current-head CLI proof, and review/land the dependency stack in order.

options.title: Keep Claws read-only for now
options.body: Retain planning-only behavior until maintainers settle the broader ownership, install, and removal lifecycle design.

options.title: Move the lifecycle out of core
options.body: Direct the optional package/workflow experience to an external plugin or ClawHub design if current extension seams can carry it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the staged core direction, require current-head CLI proof, and review/land the dependency stack in order.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline provides the clearest maintainer-routing signal for the experimental Claws product direction.
